name: How do I clean fire extinguisher powder from electronics?

mainEntity.name: How do I clean fire extinguisher powder from electronics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning fire extinguisher powder from electronics requires careful handling to prevent further damage. The powder is corrosive and can cause short circuits if not removed properly. Do not use water. Professional restoration companies use specialized equipment like HEPA vacuums and compressed air, followed by precise cleaning solutions, to safely remove residue without harming sensitive components. Attempting to clean electronics yourself can void warranties or cause irreparable damage.
